description: This file defines various batch normalization classes for PyTorch, including standard, lazy-initialized, and synchronized batch normalization variants, along with their base classes and conversion methods.

classes.name: _NormBase
classes.description: Base class providing common functionality for normalization layers, including parameter registration and state management.

classes.name: _BatchNorm
classes.description: Implementation of batch normalization with core logic for training and evaluation modes.

classes.name: _LazyNormBase
classes.description: Base class for lazy-initialized normalization layers, deferring parameter creation until input shape is known.

classes.name: BatchNorm1d
classes.description: Applies batch normalization over 2D or 3D input tensors for 1D data.

classes.name: LazyBatchNorm1d
classes.description: Lazy-initialized version of BatchNorm1d, inferring features from input shape.

classes.name: BatchNorm2d
classes.description: Applies batch normalization over 4D input tensors for 2D data (images).

classes.name: LazyBatchNorm2d
classes.description: Lazy-initialized version of BatchNorm2d, inferring features from input shape.

classes.name: BatchNorm3d
classes.description: Applies batch normalization over 5D input tensors for 3D data (volumes).

classes.name: LazyBatchNorm3d
classes.description: Lazy-initialized version of BatchNorm3d, inferring features from input shape.

classes.name: SyncBatchNorm
classes.description: Batch normalization that synchronizes statistics across multiple processes in distributed training.

methods.name: reset_running_stats
methods.description: Resets running mean, variance, and batch count buffers.

methods.name: reset_parameters
methods.description: Initializes or resets parameters and buffers to default states.

methods.name: _check_input_dim
methods.description: Checks that input tensor has the expected number of dimensions for the layer.

methods.name: extra_repr
methods.description: Returns a string representation of layer configuration.

methods.name: _load_from_state_dict
methods.description: Loads state from a checkpoint, handling version-specific adjustments.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Performs the batch normalization operation on input tensor.

methods.name: convert_sync_batchnorm
methods.description: Converts all BatchNorm layers in a module to SyncBatchNorm for distributed training.
